title: Multimodal Clinical Benchmark for Emergency Care (MC-BEC): A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Foundation Models in Emergency Medicine

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating True Positive Rate (TPR) differences, Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Disparate Impact (DI), and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) across different age groups (e.g., < 55 vs >= 55, Seniors vs Adults) to identify underdiagnosis bias in clinical prediction tasks.

Calculating True Positive Rate (TPR) differences, Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Disparate Impact (DI), and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) between male and female patients to identify underdiagnosis bias in clinical prediction tasks.

Calculating True Positive Rate (TPR) differences, Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Disparate Impact (DI), and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) across various racial groups (White, Black/African American, Asian, Native Hawaiian/Other Pacific Islander, Other) to identify underdiagnosis bias in clinical prediction tasks.

Calculating True Positive Rate (TPR) differences, Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Disparate Impact (DI), and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) between Hispanic/Latino and Non-Hispanic/Non-Latino groups to identify underdiagnosis bias in clinical prediction tasks.
